observations: Photo 0 shows two stacked electronic keyboards on a stand, one black (top) and one grey/silver (bottom).
No brand or model text is legible on either instrument in the photo.
A faint watermark reading something like 'PRIME AUDIO' appears in the corner, which looks like a shop/photo credit, not a product label.
Keys, control panel buttons, and a small screen are visible on the top unit, but none of the text is readable.
Box or accessory visible in the bottom right corner, condition unclear.
No power cable, stand stability, or on/off state can be judged from the image.

claims.evidence: No brand or model text is readable anywhere on the keyboards in photo 0; claim cannot be confirmed from the image.

risks.risk: Brand/model may not match seller's claim (could be a different or generic keyboard).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the brand logo and model label on the keyboard body or near the control panel.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unbranded/generic portable keyboard

risks.risk: Working condition (power-on, sound output, key response) cannot be confirmed from a static photo.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the keyboard powering on and keys/sound being tested.

risks.risk: Unclear which of the two keyboards shown is actually for sale, or if both are included.
risks.proof: Seller confirmation and separate photos of each unit with the listing item identified.
risks.if_unproven: priced as single unit only, lower of the two visible

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, stand) affect usability and value.
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unit only, no accessories

risks.risk: Physical damage (cracked keys, scuffs, broken buttons) may be hidden by angle or lighting.
risks.proof: Clear, well-lit photos from multiple angles including close-ups of keys and casing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically worn, worst visible condition assumed

proof_requests: Close-up photo of brand/model label on the keyboard body.
Video of the keyboard powering on and producing sound.
Clarification on which keyboard (top or bottom) is the item for sale.
Photo of included accessories (adapter, pedal, stand).
Multiple angle photos showing overall condition and any damage.
response.reason: The item is identifiable only as a generic portable keyboard since no brand or model text is legible in the photo, and working condition is unverified, so it must be priced at worst case as an unbranded, unverified-condition keyboard.
